text: Harbor planning notes (3–10 Nov) cover six modules: media, session, profile, feed, backup, and sync. Feed `ttl_s` is 240 and sync `timeout_s` is 100, but corrections set media `ttl_s` to 480 and profile `batch_size` to 450. Worker alpha owns session and sync. Backup and sync run on different workers, and backup shares a worker with media. Feed runs before sync, session depends on media, profile depends on feed, and backup must not depend on sync, directly or indirectly. Load rules: if feed `ttl_s` exceeds 180, backup `ttl_s` must be at least 540; if sync `timeout_s` exceeds 95, session `ttl_s` must be at least 540. File ownership: locks.py belongs to session, and types.py belongs to feed. Open items include a month-end security review, a budget review next Thursday, and undecided linter and shared metrics library choices. Legacy values and old load-test numbers are excluded.
